$comment: Operations the live probe will not call on its own.
Everything else runs, including every DELETE — but a DELETE only ever
points at a resource this run created. The entries below are different:
they destroy the account, revoke the credential the run depends on, or
change state for every tenant on the platform. Running them would end the
run and could not be undone, so they need a human decision.
Remove an entry, or pass --allow <operationId>, to run it anyway.

operations.purgeAdminTenant: deletes an entire tenant and everything in it
operations.deleteUser: can delete the owner the API key belongs to
operations.revokeApiKey: can revoke the key this run is authenticating with
operations.revokeMeSession: can revoke the session this run is authenticating with
operations.logout: invalidates the credential mid-run; every later call would 401
operations.unlinkAuthProvider: can remove the last way to sign in to the account
operations.adminDeleteOAuthProvider: removes a login provider for every user on the platform
operations.deleteLlmProviderKey: destroys stored provider credentials that cannot be read back
operations.deleteSpawnPolicy: removes the platform-wide agent spawn policy
operations.clearRateLimits: drops rate limiting for the whole platform
operations.deleteDataExplorerValue: deletes an arbitrary key from live storage
operations.bulkDeleteNotifications: deletes notifications this run did not create
operations.emptyWorkspaceTrash: permanently destroys items the tenant put in the trash
operations.adminPutVoicePresets: overwrites the platform voice presets with synthesised values

caution.$comment: These run, but have effects outside the platform and are called out in the report.
caution.createCheckoutSession: creates a payment session with the billing provider
caution.publishListing: makes a listing publicly visible in the marketplace
caution.createRun: consumes model tokens, which cost money
caution.invokeMarketplaceAgent: consumes model tokens, which cost money
